task_title: ruff format auger.py clean on main
task_criteria: AC1: ruff format --check auger.py exits 0 on clean main. AC2: reformat is its own commit, git diff -w shows no token changes, gate stays green. AC3: a fresh auger.py commit passes gitreins tier-1 lint exit_code=0 without hook bypass.

items.criterion: AC1: ruff format --check auger.py exits 0 on clean main. AC2: reformat is its own commit, git diff -w shows no token changes, gate stays green. AC3: a fresh auger.py commit passes gitreins tier-1 lint exit_code=0 without hook bypass.
items.detail: AC1 passes: on main HEAD 7b003e4, `ruff format --check auger.py` printed `1 file already formatted` and exited 0; `git status --porcelain -- auger.py` and `git diff HEAD -- auger.py` were empty. AC2 and AC3 fail: `git rev-list --count main..wt/AUG-190` returned 0 and `git diff --quiet main wt/AUG-190 -- auger.py` returned 0, so there is no AUG-190 reformat commit or auger.py delta. The submitted worktree diff only adds an unrelated REVIEW-AUGER-009 entry to .gitreins/tasks.yaml. The latest auger.py commit d499323 changes auger.py plus tests/conftest.py and tests/test_auger.py, and `git diff -w d499323^ d499323 -- auger.py` exits 1 with 5069 bytes of substantive changes. No AUG-190 verdict/history record or fresh auger.py commit was found. The available passing tier-1 record 8798c8b6 is for AUG-172 at board-only commit 7b003e4, not this task. Direct `ruff check auger.py` passed, but that does not prove the required fresh commit/hook path. The direct gate command was terminated by the 30-second tool timeout after syntax/lint and partial pytest; prior tier-1 output ending `GATE PASS` is not evidence for an AUG-190 reformat.

items.criterion: Reachability: the submitted main/HEAD history must contain the actual auger.py formatting change, not only an unrelated task-board update; identify the reformat commit and its path.
items.detail: No reachable AUG-190 reformat change exists. `git rev-list --count main..wt/AUG-190` = 0; `git diff --name-only main..wt/AUG-190` lists only .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl, .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl, and .gitreins/tasks.yaml. `git diff --quiet main wt/AUG-190 -- auger.py` = 0, and both refs resolve auger.py to blob 4a41a829. HEAD 7b003e4 and branch tip b5f1ae8 are metadata commits.

items.criterion: Diff integrity: the reformat commit must be isolated to auger.py and its parent-to-commit diff must be whitespace-only (git diff -w empty), with no token/AST changes.
items.detail: There is no isolated reformat commit to validate. A scan of all 119 commits touching auger.py found no single-file commit with an empty parent-to-commit `git diff -w`. The latest auger.py commit d499323 has three changed files and `git diff -w d499323^ d499323 -- auger.py` exits 1 with 5069 bytes of substantive diff.

items.criterion: Hook evidence: the claimed fresh auger.py commit and tier-1 lint result must be tied to the repository's actual configured hook/lint path, with no --no-verify or other hook bypass.
items.detail: The installed .git/hooks/pre-commit invokes `/home/kara/.local/share/pipx/venvs/gitreins/bin/gitreins guard`, and .gitreins/config.yaml selects staged Python files for built-in lint. However, no AUG-190 verdict/history record or fresh auger.py commit exists. The available verdict 8798c8b6 explicitly has task_id=AUG-172 and commit=7b003e4; its lint exit_code=0 cannot establish AUG-190's required fresh-commit, no-bypass proof.
